text:
alex.k: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need a customer-facing status update and to lock down who gets the RCA and what gets redacted. Who can own copy + distribution?

priya: I can draft the statuspage copy. Prefer a short public blurb + promise of a follow-up summary in 72h.

sam: We should also decide whether to publish a full RCA or a summarized external note. Legal asked for a template for redactions.

maria: Suggest workflow: 1) statuspage short blurb (public) 2) 72h external summary (detailed, but redacted PII) 3) full RCA shared only with customers who request + NDAs if needed.

alex.k: OK. Let's make concrete action items so nothing slips. I care about owners and deadlines.

priya: Draft action items below — please react with :thumbsup: if you accept, or mention edits.

```
AI-001: Priya — Draft statuspage public copy by EOD tomorrow (Thu) and post to Statuspage for review.
AI-002: Sam — Produce 72h external summary draft (includes timeline, mitigations, next steps) by Fri noon.
AI-003: Maria — Work with Legal to produce redaction checklist & consent matrix by Fri EOD.
AI-004: Support Lead — Identify customers to proactively notify and add outreach owners by Fri EOD.
AI-005: Alex — Coordinate posting cadence and confirm who can approve the public copy (final approver: @maria).
```

support-lead: I accept AI-004. I'll export the impacted customer list and share owners by Thu afternoon.

sam: Accept AI-002. I'll include the recurring-patterns paragraph — we keep seeing a failover spike every ~48h on the DB cluster; will propose runbook changes.

maria: Accept AI-003 but want Legal to sign off on the wording. I'll put together the checklist and a short template redaction note.

incident-bot: Reminder — add AI items to postmortem ticket PM-462 and set due dates.

alex.k: Priya — can you drop a first-draft statuspage blurb here so we can iterate? Keep it consumer-friendly.

priya: Draft below (very short):

"We experienced elevated error rates impacting API requests between 03:12–04:05 UTC. Root cause: an unexpected DB failover triggered by circuit-breaker congestion. Impact: intermittent 5xx responses for ~15% of requests. Mitigation: traffic routing and manual failover completed; full recovery at 04:05 UTC. We will publish a follow-up summary with details and next steps within 72 hours."

sam: Looks good. Add link to status updates for customers and mention apologies.

priya: Updated draft with tiny edits:

"We experienced intermittent API errors from 03:12–04:05 UTC caused by a DB failover triggered by an internal circuit-breaker. Impacted customers may have seen 5xx responses; normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting traffic and completing failover. We apologize for the disruption. A detailed summary and next steps will be published within 72 hours."

alex.k: Good. Maria, once Legal okays redaction template, can you confirm whether we include technical details (e.g., runbook steps) in the 72h summary or hold them for full RCA?

maria: Plan: 72h summary = timeline, impact metrics, mitigations, and high-level mitigation plan. Full RCA will include deeper technical dive and playbook updates; only shared on request with appropriate access.

support-lead: Q: For customers on Dedicated, do we proactively send the 72h summary or wait for support outreach?

sam: Proactively send to Dedicated + any customers we know were impacted; support team will follow up for those that request the full RCA.

alex.k: Great. Next steps: Priya posts the statuspage draft to the Statuspage draft workspace and ping @maria for approval. Sam drops 72h summary skeleton into the postmortem ticket. Maria posts redaction checklist to the ticket. Support lead shares outreach owners. I'll close the loop once items are in the ticket.

priya: Will do — I'll post draft in 1h.

sam: I'll start the 72h doc now.

maria: I'll schedule a 20m review with Legal for the redaction checklist Thu morning.

alex.k: Thanks all. Also note recurring-incident flag: Sam, please include proposed runbook edits and recurrence mitigation plan in the 72h doc so we can prioritize in the next ops sprint.

sam: Will do.

support-lead: Marking AI-004 accepted in the ticket.

alex.k: [closing] I'll follow up in the postmortem ticket once I see all deliverables. If anyone can't hit their ETA, please call it out in this thread.

priya: :thumbsup:
